title: The East Stair
description: The last midwinter, carrying its coal down from the flame, Wynn Sallow stopped on the Hearthspire's east stair, and a novice on the landing with a light cupped in their hands said, 'Keep one back this year, Keeper Sallow.' A name that was in the Book and nowhere else. Wynn never asked who. The door-warden of the east stair saw every face go by.

stages.text: The door-warden of the east stair was Brother Aldous Wren, who sits on a bench by his family's old house in Saltmarrow. Oda's lanes run back east and south: Thornwold to Saltmarrow. Ask him who was on the east landing the last midwinter.
